name: viberdocs
description: Publish, edit and download ViberDocs docs and templates, with a bundled command-line tool for the shell and the ViberDocs connector beside it.

interface.longDescription: ViberDocs turns an HTML file into a shared, versioned doc at a link. This plugin publishes, updates, previews and downloads ViberDocs docs and saves document templates. In a session with a shell and Node 22 or 24, its skill runs a small bundled command-line tool so a doc's files never pass through the conversation. The ViberDocs connector lets the assistant browse your workspaces, folders and docs, and edit, preview and publish drafts without a shell.
capabilities: Publish an HTML file or a folder of files as a ViberDocs doc
Pull a doc, edit it and publish the next version with a conflict check
Preview a draft at a short-lived link before it goes live
Browse and search workspaces, folders and docs
Create and update document templates and styles
defaultPrompt: Publish this HTML file to ViberDocs
Pull my ViberDocs doc so I can edit it
Find my ViberDocs docs about the roadmap
